**Transfer Function Texture (`transferTex`):** A 2D texture mapping opacity (alpha) to RGB color.
**Render Target Texture (`rtTexture`):** A 2D texture storing world-space coordinates of the ray entry point (back face of the volume box).
-   Render the back face of the volume bounding box.

-   **Diagonal Clipping:** The ray length through the volume can exceed 1.0 in normalized space.
-   **Time Complexity:** $O(\text{steps} \cdot \text{resolution})$ per fragment, where `steps` is the number of ray marching iterations.
